sha.description: SHA is the commit hash as the session saw it, abbreviated or full.

repo.description: Repo is the root of the repository that holds the commit, when it could be resolved.

subject.description: Subject is the commit's first message line, when it could be read from git.

at.description: At is when the session created or referenced the commit.

CommitRef.description: CommitRef is a commit a session created or referenced.

repos.description: Repos are the repositories the session worked in, read, modified, or mentioned.

files.description: Files are the files the session read or modified through the harness's own tools.

commits.description: Commits are the commits the session created or referenced.

workRefs.description:
WorkRefs are work-tracking identifiers, such as initiative and roadmap-item IDs,
found in the session.

Evidence.description: Evidence is what a session touched, derived from the structured tool records in its transcript and from git, not from text the model wrote.

path.description: Path is the absolute path of the file.

read.description: Read is set when the session read the file through a harness tool.

modified.description: Modified is set when the session wrote or edited the file.

lastSeen.description: LastSeen is when the session last touched the file.

FileActivity.description: FileActivity says whether a session read or modified one file.

at.description: At is when the prompt was sent.

text.description: Text is the prompt text, truncated.

Prompt.description: Prompt is a human-authored message, truncated for display.

root.description: Root is the repository's root directory.

id.description:
ID identifies the repository, such as github.com/org/repo, derived from its origin
remote. It is empty when the repository has no remote.

cwd.description: CWD is set when the session started in this repository.

executed.description: Executed is set when a command ran with this repository as its working directory.

read.description: Read is set when the session read a file in this repository through a harness tool.

modified.description: Modified is set when the session wrote or edited a file in this repository.

mentioned.description: Mentioned is set when the repository was named in a prompt but not otherwise observed.

fileCount.description: FileCount is the number of distinct files read or modified in this repository.

firstSeen.description: FirstSeen is the earliest observed activity in this repository.

lastSeen.description: LastSeen is the latest observed activity in this repository.

RepoActivity.description: RepoActivity says how a session relates to one repository.

argv.description: Argv is the command and arguments that resume the session.

dir.description: Dir is the directory to run the command from.

ResumeSpec.description: ResumeSpec says how to resume a session.

pid.description: PID is the operating-system process ID of the harness.

Runtime.description: Runtime describes the live process attached to a running session.

harness.description: Harness is the coding-agent tool that owns the session: claude-code or codex.

id.description: ID is the harness's own session identifier, durable across process exit and reboot.

cwd.description: CWD is the directory the session was started in. Resuming must happen from here.

gitBranch.description: GitBranch is the git branch recorded for the session, when the harness records one.

gitOrigin.description: GitOrigin is the normalized origin remote, such as github.com/org/repo, when recorded.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is when the session started.

lastActivityAt.description: LastActivityAt is the last activity of any kind, including agent work.

lastHumanActivityAt.description:
LastHumanActivityAt is the last prompt a person typed. It is absent when none was found.
A large gap after LastActivityAt means the agent kept working unattended.

title.description: Title names the session. It comes from the harness when it records one.

titleSource.description: TitleSource says where Title came from: harness, first-prompt, or cwd.

recentPrompts.description:
RecentPrompts are the latest prompts a person typed, truncated. They are omitted when
prompt content is suppressed.

archived.description: Archived is set when the harness marks the session archived.

state.description: State is running, resumable, or unknown.

runtime.description: Runtime describes the live process when State is running.

resume.description: Resume says how to resume the session.

evidence.description:
Evidence is what the session touched. It is populated only when requested, because it
needs a full transcript parse.

Session.description: Session is one resumable harness session.

id.description: ID is the identifier as written, such as RMI-EXAMPLE-012.

kind.description: Kind is the name of the rule that matched it, such as initiative or rmi.

sources.description: Sources lists where it was found.

title.description: Title is the identifier's title when a resolver supplied one.

WorkRef.description: WorkRef is a work-tracking identifier found in a session.

title: OmniDevX Session
description: A resumable coding-agent session as reported by the OmniDevX session catalog.
